recommendation.summary: dsh-better-sidebar@0.22.1 is a Web-plane DSH plugin: its manifest declares dsh.client.platform=web with client injections into the DSH web UI slots, and its CI mounts the packed tarball into a real DSH instance via `dsh plugin --profile web add` and headlessly renders the DSH web UI. No SDK, ACP, headless or TUI workflow is evidenced, so only the web execution profile is selected. Node: no author recommendation exists; engines.node ">=20" is a declared-support floor and the CI/release lanes are configured with node-version 22, so 22 is preferred (ci-tested) with 20 retained as declared-support. Development package manager is pnpm 11.8.0 (packageManager, read by pnpm/action-setup). The only author DSH baseline found is 0.1.7-rc.1, pinned in the plugin-mount CI lane; the plugin's ^0.1.7-rc.1 peer ranges do not cover the 0.2.0-rc.1 target host, so compatibility is not established by this recommendation.
